title: diploclinium angustifolium
intro: Diploclinium angustifolium, commonly known as Diploclinium, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. It is known for its medicinal properties, which provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities.
